hypothesis: An independent consecutive-excerpt language pass without summary or story-design assessment detects grammar and cumulative voice separately.
inputs: 01-04 first four consecutive utterances; 05 complete unrelated three-utterance story. Exactly the previously frozen words; original indices retained. No author A/B samples, votes, criteria or previous reviews in requests.

initial_success.01: Both a required exact case correction and a required concrete passage/wording repair grounded in neighboring stylized opening phrases, preserving the inspection-to-interviews transition. Grammar-only is failure. Praise or a vague style label is not repair.
initial_success.04: No invented grammar defect or required opening style rewrite; optional justified copyediting allowed. Useful image and transition remain allowed.
initial_success.05: No invented grammar defect or required style rewrite; the train-window metaphor is not treated as intrinsically defective. Empty findings is valid.

followup_success.02: Required cumulative wording repair despite corrected grammar; no accusation about corrected numeral.
followup_success.03: Required correction of the retained case error; no required cumulative rewrite of the already edited opening.

stop: At most three initial calls and two conditional calls; no prompt iteration or automatic retries. If initial criteria fail, save the failure and stop. All calls use Terra medium, strict schema, identical prompt and 24576 max output tokens.
